description: This file defines a React component 'TopReferralSourcesBarChart' that renders a responsive, horizontal bar chart showing the top referral sources with user counts. It fetches data from an API, processes it, and displays it with custom tooltips and labels.

methods.name: TopReferralSourcesBarChart
